notes.title: UI & XP System Polish
notes.notes:
Added an indicator on a turret node to make it more noticeable where you can buy turrets.

Added a breakable object that works as a vacuum to easily collect experience gems.

notes.title: Boss & XP
notes.notes:
Some players faced a problem where they leveled up more than once with an experience gem but got more stat selection panels than they should have.

Some players faced the first boss over and over when they shouldn't.

These are fixed now.

Thank you for your feedbacks.
